heading.zh-Hant: 出身與一戰
heading.en: Origins and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 阿方斯·朱安是駐莫斯塔加奈姆憲兵的兒子，在阿爾及利亞讀中學，1910年進入聖西爾軍校，1912年以全班第一名畢業，之後在摩洛哥服役兩年。一戰期間他在摩洛哥輕步兵部隊作戰，1915年負傷，右臂失去功能；1916年12月起指揮第1摩洛哥步兵團的一個機槍連，1918年10月轉入第153步兵師參謀部。
body.en: Alphonse Juin was the son of a gendarme posted at Mostaganem and studied in Algeria. He entered Saint-Cyr in 1910, graduated top of his class in 1912 and then served two years in Morocco. Wounded in 1915 he lost the use of his right arm; from December 1916 he commanded a machine-gun company of the 1st Moroccan Rifles, and in October 1918 joined the staff of the 153rd Infantry Division.

citations.quote: Fils d’un gendarme en poste à Mostaganem
avant d’intégrer Saint-Cyr en 1910
Sorti major de sa promotion en 1912
il servit pendant deux ans au Maroc
Blessé en 1915, il perdit l’usage de son bras droit
en décembre 1916, le commandement d’une compagnie de mitrailleuses
En octobre 1918 enfin
rejoindre l’état-major de la 153e division d’infanterie

heading.zh-Hant: 戰間期：摩洛哥與北非
heading.en: Inter-war years: Morocco and North Africa

body.zh-Hant: 戰後，朱安先在戰爭學院任教一年，再回到非洲，在里夫地區作戰。其後他在軍中逐級晉升，出任北非武裝部隊參謀長，1938年底升為非洲軍團將官。
body.en: After the war Juin taught for a year at the École de guerre before returning to Africa, where he fought in the Rif. He then rose through every grade of the hierarchy, became chief of staff of the armed forces of North Africa, and at the end of 1938 a general of the Army of Africa.

citations.quote: il enseigna une année à l’École de guerre
où il se battit dans le Rif
il gravit tous les échelons de la hiérarchie militaire
fut promu chef d’état-major des forces armées de l’Afrique du Nord
à la fin de l’année 1938, général de l’armée d’Afrique

heading.zh-Hant: 1939至1942年：法國戰役與北非總司令
heading.en: 1939–1942: the Battle of France and the North African command

body.zh-Hant: 1939年戰爭爆發時，朱安出任第15摩托化步兵師師長。1940年5月他掩護敦克爾克方向的撤退，5月19日被俘。1941年6月，在維琪政府要求下獲釋，接替魏剛出任北非部隊總司令；1942年11月他倒向美軍。
body.en: When war was declared in 1939 Juin was given command of the 15th Motorised Infantry Division. In May 1940 he covered the retreat at Dunkirk and was taken prisoner on 19 May. Released at Vichy’s request in June 1941, he succeeded Weygand as commander-in-chief of the forces in North Africa; in November 1942 he rallied to the Americans.

citations.quote: il fut nommé commandant de la 15e division d’infanterie motorisée
Il couvrit la retraite de Dunkerque en mai 1940
fut fait prisonnier le 19 mai
Libéré à la demande de Vichy en juin 1941
pour succéder à Weygand comme commandant en chef des forces d’Afrique du Nord
S’étant rallié aux Américains en novembre 1942

heading.zh-Hant: 突尼西亞與義大利戰役
heading.en: The Tunisian and Italian campaigns

body.zh-Hant: 倒向美軍後，朱安率法軍部隊在突尼西亞戰役中擋下軸心國軍隊，並參與消滅非洲軍團。戴高樂其後召他出任義大利的法國遠征軍司令；1944年5月的義大利戰役中，他的部隊在加里利亞諾河一線突破德軍防線，打開通往羅馬與錫耶納之路。
body.en: After rallying to the Americans, Juin led the French contingent that halted the Axis force in Tunisia and helped destroy the Afrikakorps. De Gaulle then called him to head the French expeditionary corps in Italy; in May 1944 it broke through the German front on the Garigliano, opening the road to Rome and Siena.

citations.quote: il prit la tête du contingent français qui arrêta la force de l’Axe en Tunisie
contribua à l’anéantissement de l’Afrikacorps
Appelé par de Gaulle à la tête du corps expéditionnaire français en Italie
perça en mai 1944 le front allemand sur le Garigliano
ouvrant la route de Rome et de Sienne

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後職務與晚年
heading.en: Post-war posts and later life

body.zh-Hant: 1945至1947年，朱安任國防總參謀長；1947至1951年任駐摩洛哥總督（résident général）；其後任武裝部隊總監，並於1951至1956年擔任北約中歐地區盟軍陸上部隊指揮官。1952年他晉升法國元帥，同年11月20日當選法蘭西學術院院士，1967年1月27日去世。
body.en: Juin was chief of the general staff of national defence from 1945 to 1947 and resident-general in Morocco from 1947 to 1951. He was then inspector-general of the armed forces and, from 1951 to 1956, held the allied command of land forces in the Centre-Europe sector of NATO. He became a Marshal of France in 1952, was elected to the Académie française on 20 November 1952 and died on 27 January 1967.

Élevé à la dignité de maréchal de France en 1952

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與一戰
heading.en: Origins and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 烏戈·卡瓦萊羅1880年9月20日生於卡薩萊蒙費拉托，1898年起接受軍事教育，1912年以上尉身分參加利比亞戰爭。一戰期間他一直在最高統帥部任職，1917至1918年以中校身分主持作戰處，是巴多格里奧的合作者，並參與擬定皮亞韋河與維托里奧·韋內托戰役的計畫；戰爭結束時年僅38歲便升將官，被派往巴黎。
body.en: Ugo Cavallero was born at Casale Monferrato on 20 September 1880, began military studies in 1898 and took part in the Libyan war in 1912 as a captain. Throughout the First World War he served at the Supreme Command, heading its operations office in 1917–18 as a lieutenant colonel and collaborating with Badoglio; he had a leading part in drawing up the plans for the battles of the Piave and Vittorio Veneto. At the war’s end he was promoted general at only thirty-eight and sent to Paris.

Avviato agli studi militari nel 1898
Nel 1912 partecipò alla guerra libica col grado di capitano
fu sempre addetto al Comando Supremo

divenendo collaboratore di Badoglio
Ebbe parte di rilievo nell'elaborazione dei piani

inviato a Parigi quale membro del comitato permanente interalleato

heading.zh-Hant: 戰間期：次長、實業與參議員
heading.en: Inter-war years: undersecretary, industry and the Senate

body.zh-Hant: 1920年卡瓦萊羅應自己的請求轉入特別輔助役，後來在民間企業任職，曾任皮雷利公司中央主任。1925年5月他出任戰爭部次長，至1928年止；1928年在國王介入下被免職。他自1926年起是參議員，其後擔任安薩爾多公司董事長，1933年因重大嫌疑離開該公司。
body.en: In 1920 Cavallero was placed, at his own request, in special auxiliary status and worked in private industry, becoming a central director of Pirelli. In May 1925 he was appointed undersecretary for War and remained so until 1928, when the king had him removed. A senator from 1926, he then chaired the Ansaldo company, which he had to leave in 1933.

heading.zh-Hant: 東非指揮與鋼鐵盟約委員會
heading.en: East Africa and the Pact of Steel commission

body.zh-Hant: 1937年底卡瓦萊羅重新服役，以軍團將官身分指揮剛征服的東非部隊。1939年春，因與副王奧斯塔公爵阿梅德奧不和被召回國，並出任執行德義「鋼鐵盟約」的經濟與軍事委員會副主席；1939年6月他帶著墨索里尼致希特勒的信前往柏林。
body.en: Recalled to service at the end of 1937, Cavallero commanded, as a corps general, the troops in newly conquered East Africa. In spring 1939 he was called home over disagreements with the viceroy Amedeo d’Aosta and became vice-president of the economic and military commission for applying the Pact of Steel; in June 1939 he carried to Berlin a letter from Mussolini to Hitler.

vicepresidente della commissione economica e militare
nel giugno 1939

heading.zh-Hant: 參謀總長任命與阿爾巴尼亞戰線
heading.en: Appointment as chief of the general staff and the Albanian front

body.zh-Hant: 1940年12月6日，在巴多格里奧辭職後，卡瓦萊羅被任命為全軍參謀總長。12月30日他前往阿爾巴尼亞，接替索杜指揮當地集團軍，1941年1月底擋住希臘軍的攻勢；3月在德斯尼察谷地的反攻失敗，4月則配合德軍行動，推進到杜布羅夫尼克。
body.en: On 6 December 1940, after Badoglio resigned, Cavallero was named chief of the general staff. On 30 December he took command of the army group in Albania in place of Soddu and at the end of January 1941 blocked the Greek initiative; the Italian counter-offensive in the Desnizza valley failed in March, and in April he exploited the German success, advancing to Ragusa.

citations.quote: fu nominato capo di Stato Maggiore generale il 6 dic. 1940

heading.en: Origins and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 伊塔洛·巴爾博1896年6月6日生於費拉拉省的誇爾泰薩納。一戰爆發後他志願入伍，任山地兵少尉；1917年秋在都靈上飛行員課程，1918年1月起指揮「皮耶韋迪卡多雷」營的突擊隊，一直打到格拉帕山最後一役，獲兩枚銀質與一枚銅質勳章。1920年10月他取得佛羅倫斯大學學位。
body.en: Italo Balbo was born at Quartesana (Ferrara) on 6 June 1896. When the war broke out he volunteered and became an Alpini second lieutenant; in autumn 1917 he took a pilot course at Turin, and from January 1918 he commanded the arditi unit of the "Pieve di Cadore" battalion, fighting to the last action on the Grappa and winning two silver medals and one bronze. He graduated in October 1920.

body.en: Returning to Ferrara in December 1920, Balbo joined the local Fascio and, drawing on his experience as an arditi officer, led the first "punitive expeditions". He was elected political secretary of the Ferrara Fascio on 13 February and provincial secretary on 12 June. On 12 May 1922 he gathered 63,000 rural workers of the province at Ferrara and proclaimed the "Fascist strike".

heading.zh-Hant: 航空部與大規模空中巡航
heading.en: The Air Ministry and mass air cruises

body.zh-Hant: 巴爾博1926至1929年任航空次長，1929至1933年任航空部長。他親自率領大型機群長程巡航：1928年有一次在西地中海、出動61架水上偵察機的巡航，1930年12月是首次飛往里約熱內盧的大西洋巡航，1933年春則是第二次，目的地為芝加哥。結束後他被授予空軍元帥銜，1933年因空軍預算削減而被免去部長職。
body.en: Balbo was undersecretary for Aeronautics from 1926 to 1929 and minister from 1929 to 1933. He personally led long mass flights: in 1928 a cruise in the western Mediterranean with 61 reconnaissance seaplanes, in December 1930 the first Atlantic cruise to Rio de Janeiro, and in spring 1933 the second, to Chicago. He was then named Marshal of the Air, but in 1933, with the air budget cut, he was dismissed as minister.

heading.zh-Hant: 利比亞總督與陣亡
heading.en: Governor of Libya and death

body.zh-Hant: 1934年1月，巴爾博接替巴多格里奧出任利比亞總督。他在1935至1936年間修築了長1820公里、從突尼西亞通到埃及的沿海公路。後來他取得利比亞全部武裝力量的指揮權，1940年6月28日在托布魯克上空被義大利自己的防空火力誤擊身亡。
body.en: In January 1934 Balbo was appointed governor of Libya in place of Badoglio. In 1935–36 he had the 1,820 km Libyan coastal road built from Tunisia to Egypt. He later took command of all Libyan armed forces and died over Tobruk on 28 June 1940, hit by mistake by Italian anti-aircraft fire.

heading.zh-Hant: 高原與格拉帕山戰役、1940年利比亞作戰
heading.en: Highlands and Grappa battles; the 1940 Libyan campaign

body.zh-Hant: 一戰期間，巴爾博以山地兵少尉身分在高原地帶（Altipiani）的最前線作戰；1918年1月起指揮突擊隊，一直打到格拉帕山戰役的最後一次行動。1940年義大利參戰後，他以利比亞武裝力量指揮官的身分，一再要求取得足夠的攻防裝備。6月21日他催促墨索里尼向德國索取戰車，作為對埃及攻勢的「鋼鐵尖兵」；6月28日下午，他的座機在托布魯克被義軍自己的防空砲火擊落身亡。
body.en: In the First World War Balbo, as an Alpini sub-lieutenant, served in the front line on the Altipiani; from January 1918 he led an arditi detachment and fought up to the last action of the Grappa battle. After Italy entered the Second World War in 1940, as commander of all armed forces in Libya he repeatedly demanded adequate means of attack and defence. On 21 June he pressed Mussolini to ask the Germans for tanks as the steel spearhead of the offensive against Egypt; on the afternoon of 28 June his aircraft was shot down over Tobruk by Italian anti-aircraft fire.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與早年
heading.en: Origins and early career

body.zh-Hant: 佩特羅·巴多格里奧1871年9月28日生於蒙費拉托的格拉扎諾。他進入都靈的砲兵與工兵學院，1890年11月16日被任命為砲兵少尉。1911年10月，他奉命前往利比亞，隨輜重部隊登船出發。
body.en: Pietro Badoglio was born at Grazzano Monferrato on 28 September 1871. He entered the artillery and engineering academy at Turin and was commissioned an artillery second lieutenant on 16 November 1890. In October 1911 he received orders to leave for Libya and embarked with the supply troops.

heading.zh-Hant: 一戰：戈里齊亞、卡波雷托與維托里奧·韋內托
heading.en: First World War: Gorizia, Caporetto and Vittorio Veneto

body.zh-Hant: 1916年5月10日，巴多格里奧晉升上校，並應卡佩洛之請出任其第6軍參謀長，負責戈里齊亞前線。1917年10月卡波雷托戰役時，被突破的左翼正是他指揮的第27軍。1918年2月中他成為最高統帥部唯一的副參謀長，6月27日因戰功升為集團軍司令；他參與維托里奧·韋內托戰役的籌畫，並主持停戰委員會。
body.en: On 10 May 1916 Badoglio was promoted colonel and, at General Capello’s request, named chief of staff of the VI Corps facing the Gorizia bridgehead. At Caporetto in October 1917 the penetrations fell on the left wing of the XXVII Corps, which he commanded. From mid-February 1918 he was the only deputy chief of the Supreme Command staff; on 27 June 1918 he was raised to army-commander rank for war merit, helped prepare the battle of Vittorio Veneto and presided over the armistice commission.

heading.zh-Hant: 參謀總長、元帥與利比亞總督
heading.en: Chief of the general staff, marshal and governor of Libya

body.zh-Hant: 1925年5月4日，墨索里尼任命巴多格里奧為全軍參謀總長。1926年5月11日「墨索里尼整編」陸軍之後，十五天後他被晉為義大利元帥；1927年2月6日參謀總長一職被縮減為首相的技術顧問。1928年底他被任命為的黎波里塔尼亞與昔蘭尼加總督，仍保留參謀總長職務，直到1934年2月4日離開利比亞。
body.en: On 4 May 1925 Mussolini appointed Badoglio chief of the general staff. After the "Mussolini reorganisation" of the army on 11 May 1926, he was made Marshal of Italy fifteen days later; on 6 February 1927 the post of chief of the general staff was reduced to technical adviser to the head of government. At the end of 1928 he was named governor of Tripolitania and Cyrenaica while keeping the staff post, and he left Libya definitively on 4 February 1934.

heading.zh-Hant: 衣索比亞戰役
heading.en: The Ethiopian campaign

body.zh-Hant: 巴多格里奧原本反對進攻衣索比亞。墨索里尼要由法西斯將領、四人團成員德博諾進攻，但德博諾在他眼中推進過慢，由巴多格里奧取代；1935年11月30日他在馬薩瓦登陸。1936年5月5日他進入亞的斯亞貝巴，5月9日帝國宣告成立，他被任命為衣索比亞副王，11日獲封亞的斯亞貝巴公爵，隨即把職位交給格拉齊亞尼，回國恢復參謀總長職務。
body.en: Badoglio had been against the Ethiopian enterprise. Mussolini would have preferred the quadrumvir De Bono, but his advance was too slow in Mussolini’s eyes and Badoglio replaced him, landing at Massawa on 30 November 1935. On 5 May 1936 he entered Addis Ababa; the empire was proclaimed on 9 May, he was named viceroy of Ethiopia and on the 11th Duke of Addis Ababa, but he at once left the post to General Graziani to return to Italy and resume the general staff.

heading.zh-Hant: 辭職與1943至1944年政府
heading.en: Resignation and the 1943–44 government

body.zh-Hant: 1940年12月4日，希臘前線失利後巴多格里奧辭去參謀總長之職。1943年7月25日墨索里尼垮台，國王選他領導新政府，7月26日晚公布的公告仍稱戰爭繼續。9月3日在卡西比萊簽署停戰協定；一份為其政府辯護的備忘錄涵蓋1943年9月3日至1944年6月5日羅馬解放之間的施政。
body.en: Badoglio resigned as chief of the general staff on 4 December 1940 after the reverses on the Greek front. After Mussolini’s fall on 25 July 1943 the king chose him to head the new government, whose proclamation broadcast on the evening of 26 July said the war continued. The armistice was signed at Cassibile on 3 September, and a memorial defending his government’s work covers 3 September 1943 to the liberation of Rome on 5 June 1944.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、利比亞與一戰
heading.en: Origins, Libya and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 喬瓦尼·梅塞1883年12月10日生於布林迪西附近的梅薩涅，是十一個孩子中的第五個，年輕時當過泥水匠學徒。1901年12月31日他入伍，1903年9月5日志願赴中國；1910年9月17日從摩德納軍校畢業成為少尉。1911年10月他前往利比亞，在西迪梅斯里與扎恩祖爾之役中表現突出。一戰期間他自1917年1月29日起在義奧戰線服役，1918年1月16日接掌第9突擊隊，在格拉帕山戰鬥，10月29日負傷並升中校。
body.en: Giovanni Messe was born at Mesagne near Brindisi on 10 December 1883, the fifth of eleven children, and worked young as a mason’s apprentice. He enlisted on 31 December 1901, volunteered for China on 5 September 1903 and left the Modena military school as a second lieutenant on 17 September 1910. In October 1911 he went to Libya, distinguishing himself at Sidi Messri and Zanzur. In the First World War he reached the Italo-Austrian front on 29 January 1917, took command of the IX assault unit on 16 January 1918, fought on the Grappa, and on 29 October was wounded and promoted lieutenant colonel.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰間期：突擊隊、侍從武官與團長
heading.en: Inter-war years: assault units, aide-de-camp and regimental command

body.zh-Hant: 1919年4月24日，梅塞轉任羅馬軍團的突擊隊指揮；1920年6月他隨第9突擊隊前往發羅拉，19日與阿爾巴尼亞起義者激戰。1923年4月15日起他擔任國王的實任侍從武官，1927年6月28日升上校，接掌駐阿斯蒂的第9狙擊兵團；1929年4月該團移駐扎達爾，他同時是當地駐軍指揮官。
body.en: On 24 April 1919 Messe passed to command the arditi of the Rome army corps; in June 1920 he went with the IX unit to Valona and on the 19th fought a violent clash with Albanian insurgents. From 15 April 1923 he was the king’s effective aide-de-camp; on 28 June 1927 he was promoted colonel and took over the 9th Bersaglieri at Asti, and in April 1929 the regiment moved to Zara, where he was also garrison commander.

heading.zh-Hant: 將官任命、阿爾巴尼亞與希臘戰役
heading.en: General’s rank, Albania and the Greek campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1936年1月1日梅塞升准將，二月底前往厄利垂亞，但所屬師未實際參戰。1938年6月30日他接掌第3快速師並升少將，至1940年6月；1939年4月他以遠征軍副司令身分在都拉斯登陸，參與佔領阿爾巴尼亞。1940年12月19日起他指揮特別軍團，擋住敵軍朝發羅拉的推進，並參與希臘戰役最後階段，1941年4月23日於薩洛尼卡簽署希臘停戰協定。
body.en: On 1 January 1936 Messe became a brigadier general and at the end of February sailed for Eritrea, though his division took no active part in the war. On 30 June 1938 he took command of the 3rd fast division and was promoted major general, remaining until June 1940; in April 1939, as deputy commander of the expeditionary corps, he landed at Durazzo in the occupation of Albania. From 19 December 1940 he led the special army corps, which contained the enemy advance toward Valona and took part in the last phase of the Greek campaign, ended by the armistice signed at Salonika on 23 April 1941.

heading.zh-Hant: 東線：義大利遠征軍
heading.en: The Eastern Front: the Italian Expeditionary Corps

body.zh-Hant: 1941年7月17日，梅塞被派往維也納接替患病的津加萊斯，指揮前往蘇聯的義大利遠征軍（CSIR）。他在頓涅茨盆地推進，經過「聖誕之戰」後守住陣地，並到達頓河一線。第8集團軍（Armir）抵達後，他與司令加里博爾迪的關係惡化，並請求回國，於11月1日獲准；他因此役於1942年11月15日起晉升集團軍上將。
body.en: On 17 July 1941 Messe was sent directly to Vienna to replace the sick General Zingales in command of the Italian Expeditionary Corps in Russia (CSIR). He advanced in the Donets basin, held his positions after the "battle of Christmas" and reached the Don line. After the 8th Army (Armir) arrived, his relations with its commander Gariboldi deteriorated and he asked to return home, which was granted on 1 November; he was named army general for war merit from 15 November 1942.

heading.zh-Hant: 突尼西亞與參謀總長
heading.en: Tunisia and chief of the general staff

body.zh-Hant: 1943年1月23日，梅塞被任命為義大利第1集團軍司令，防守突尼西亞邊境。馬雷特、阿卡里特、肖特與昂菲達維爾等防禦戰讓該集團軍撐到5月12日，他在墨索里尼的明確命令下投降，同時被任命為義大利元帥。1943年9月8日停戰後他獲釋返國，11月18日國王任命他為全軍參謀總長，至1945年5月1日卸任。
body.en: On 23 January 1943 Messe was named commander of the First Army, defending the Tunisian frontier. The defensive battles of Mareth, Akarit, the Chotts and Enfidaville let it hold out until 12 May, when, on Mussolini’s explicit order, which also made him Marshal of Italy, he surrendered. After the armistice of 8 September 1943 he was freed and returned to Italy, and on 18 November the king named him chief of the general staff, a post he left on 1 May 1945.
